## Motivación

El paquete **geomask** implementa geomasking reproducible para datos puntuales sensibles en salud pública y ciencias sociales. Los ejemplos usan datos sintéticos de la Región Metropolitana (`geomask_pts`).

```{r load}
library(geomask)
library(sf)
data(geomask_pts)
data(geomask_boundary)
```

## Enmascaramiento donut

```{r donut}
set.seed(42)
masked <- mask_donut(geomask_pts, min_r = 400, max_r = 1200, seed = 42)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(plot_mask_comparison(geomask_pts, masked, boundary = geomask_boundary))
  print(plot_displacement_distribution(masked))
}
```

## Comparación rápida de métodos

```{r methods}
m_rand <- mask_random_perturbation(geomask_pts, max_r = 1000, seed = 1)
m_gauss <- mask_gaussian(geomask_pts, sigma = 450, seed = 2)
m_graph <- mask_graph_k_component(geomask_pts, k = 6, knn = 10, seed = 3)
c(
  donut = median(masked$geomask_displacement_m),
  random = median(m_rand$geomask_displacement_m),
  gaussian = median(m_gauss$geomask_displacement_m),
  graph = median(m_graph$geomask_displacement_m)
)
```

## Reporte

```{r report}
mask_report(
  geomask_pts,
  masked,
  method = "donut",
  parameters = list(min_r = 400, max_r = 1200, seed = 42)
)
```
